activity_summary: You wrote Monday's lodge into the almanac for ten of the clock and forty. The Errors at two were already set. You did not write what the paper says. You shut the almanac.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the lodge hour and did not open the sealed paper onto the page.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in Ten of the clock, and forty
